top_drivers: Trump diesel export ban threat (EU 50%+ import-dependent) forcing immediate fuel-switch calculus into gas/power merit order; GB Power at 96th-pctile pricing in geopolitical tail risk.
EU Commission demand-cut signal flagging structural supply tightness; storage 15.7 pp below seasonal (70.88%) narrows Q4 refill buffer, raising winter-load risk premium.

top_takeaway: GB Power at 96th-percentile amid Trump diesel export ban threat; EU demand-cut signal and 15.7 pp storage deficit intensify fuel-switch risk into winter.
